proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for oscam, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the oscam service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the oscam
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  oscam:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.oscam.loadbalancer.server.port=8888
      - traefik.http.routers.oscam.rule=Host(`oscam.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.oscam.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.oscam.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.oscam.service=oscam
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.oscam.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.oscam.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Oscam: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-oscam/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - device /dev/ttyUSB0: For passing through smart card readers. (needs a device plugin or hostPath; not emitted).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: oscam-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: oscam-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: oscam
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: oscam
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/oscam:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: oscam-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8888
          containerPort: 8888
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: oscam-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: oscam-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: oscam-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: oscam
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: oscam
  ports:
  - name: port-8888
    port: 8888
    targetPort: 8888
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# oscam.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-oscam/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Oscam (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/oscam:latest
ContainerName=oscam
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Volume=/path/to/oscam/data:/config:Z
PublishPort=8888:8888
AddDevice=/dev/ttyUSB0:/dev/ttyUSB0

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
